plan.rationale: Router authorized a provisional merge of K3_C0001 and K3_C0002. The current boundary is weakly and partially conflictingly represented: affinity geometry shows weak positive separation in CT/WSI, very weak in RNA, and negligible in WXS (negative fraction 0.453, near chance), while structural diagnostics show the highest normalized-cut cost among the three pairs (0.657) with only moderate spectral agreement (ARI 0.702). The union spectral structure is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.572), which is merge-compatible. This supports provisional revision of A|B to A∪B; the revision returns to normal review and is not acceptance or final subtype assignment.

Router authorized a provisional 2-way split of K3_C0001_M_K3_C0002. The set-scope structural screen reports a feasible 2-way subdivision with moderate consensus separation (silhouette 0.384), relatively balanced children (33 vs 42), the lowest normalized-cut cost (0.641), and weakly positive native-view silhouettes across CT (0.125), RNA (0.060), WSI (0.088), and WXS (0.020). Higher-k solutions show markedly higher normalized-cut costs and near-zero or negative native-view silhouettes, so the 2-way solution is the only coherent feasible subdivision. This revision returns to normal review and is not acceptance or final subtype assignment.

The internal screen shows that for all three candidate sets the dominant spectral gap sits at the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1), with large leading eigengaps (0.80–0.96) and sharply decaying subsequent gaps; this describes single-cluster dominance and does not indicate a dominant internal multi-cluster subdivision. Within-set affinities (0.51–0.68) exceed between-set affinities (0.22–0.24) for every nearest pair, so the current boundaries separate regions of relatively higher internal affinity. The nearest competing boundaries are S1–S2 and S1–K3_C0003, which are pair-review entry points rather than merge conclusions. This partition-scope evidence does not establish candidate-specific membership or biological meaning, and the absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.

biological_support.dimension_interpretation: This set shows a coherent and interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, dominated by broadly down-regulated immune/inflammatory programs (allograft rejection NES -2.10, IL6-JAK-STAT3 -2.04, interferon alpha -1.98, interferon gamma -1.91, complement -1.78) with concordant HLA and T-cell leading-edge genes, alongside down-regulated oxidative phosphorylation and up-regulated UV-response-DN, Wnt/beta-catenin, and TGF-beta signaling. Enrichment magnitudes are large and the leading pathways survive stringent FDR (q=0.001). This characterizes a biological identity; it does not by itself establish that current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.
biological_support.cross_evidence_context: The partition contains three sets, so the rest combines two other candidate sets and may be heterogeneous; this set-versus-rest contrast is not an independent confirmation of the reciprocal contrasts of S1 or S2. The down-direction immune signature here is directionally opposite to the up-direction immune signature of S1, and its down-direction metabolic signature is opposite to the metabolic up-signature of S2.
